description: List the environments belonging to one shared GROUP — a group holds a separate value set per slug, so its `production` differs from its `staging`. Use this when you already have a group and want its own environments; use list_envs for an application's, and list_env_groups to see which groups an application environment pulls from. Returns Environment rows with `groupId` set: [{ id, name, slug, groupId, createdAt }].

group.description: Shared-group slug or id, as returned by list_groups (e.g. "shared-datastores").

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: list_group_envs
